description: Capability for the screen-capture overlay window only. The overlay is host-owned UI (a transparent, always-on-top layer covering the monitor under the cursor, where the user drags a selection rectangle), so it needs neither the plugin capability commands nor the desktop / box / workspace host commands: just the two commands that submit or cancel the selection. Keeping it a separate capability means that adding a future command to allow-host-commands can never silently hand it to this window.
